discoveries: Courier work makes Greg responsible for packets and paper while driver and gate officers retain movement and road authority.

discoveries: Grey Post expands Greg's map through weather, survey, and quarry systems without converting arrival into automatic advancement.

discoveries: Higher country travel keeps body state, weather, route status, and cash coupled rather than abstracting exploration into free movement.
